name: Ground pass
note: Speed grows with distance; aims a little ahead of a moving receiver (lead seconds).

name: Through ball
note: Aims where the receiver will be after lead seconds; less accurate than a plain pass.

name: Lob
note: Speed chosen so the ball lands on the target (range = v squared x sin(2 x angle) / g); lob_range_k = g / sin(2 x angle) for the chip style.

name: Shot
note: Speed = base + stat x per_stat; aim error grows as the stat drops.
